scenes.title: Новый грузчик  (The New Loader)
scenes.summary: Timur brings fish instead of what the Chef ordered. He also introduces his nephew Suslan, who is a law student.

scenes.title: Новый сушист  (The New Sushi Chef)
scenes.summary: The Chef discovers a strange new person in the kitchen who doesn't speak Russian well. He asks Aynura about him.

scenes.title: Новая кровь  (New Blood)
scenes.summary: Kristina Semyonovna calls Vika for a private conversation and tells her that the restaurant needs fresh ideas and new people.

scenes.title: Всё в прошлом  (All in the Past)
scenes.summary: Max runs into Sasha in the kitchen. Sasha asks if he is still upset about Vika leaving, but Max denies it.

scenes.title: Суши во французском ресторане  (Sushi in a French Restaurant)
scenes.summary: The Chef argues with Kristina about serving sushi in a French restaurant. Kristina reveals that Vika no longer works there.

scenes.title: Заказ  (The Order)
scenes.summary: Someone needs urgent medical help.

scenes.title: Увольнение  (The Firing)
scenes.summary: The Chef blames the supplier and decides to fire him immediately.

scenes.title: Держи  (Here You Go)
scenes.summary: A very brief exchange happens between two people handing over an item.

scenes.title: Бездомные  (The Homeless)
scenes.summary: Kostya and Max are getting ready to distribute food to the homeless.

scenes.title: Отец Насти  (Nastya's Father)
scenes.summary: An angry man comes looking for Kostya.

scenes.title: Злой папа  (Angry Dad)
scenes.summary: Max finds out that Nastya's dad came looking for Kostya but mistook Max for him and threatened him. Max is terrified.

scenes.title: Сладкая ложь  (Sweet Lie)
scenes.summary: Max begs Nastya to talk to her dad. Then they notice Valya making a dessert that looks exactly like the Chef's.

scenes.title: Где сушист?  (Where is the Sushi Chef?)
scenes.summary: The Chef confronts Senya and Fedya because Timur the sushi chef is missing and customers are waiting for sushi.

scenes.title: Разговор подруг  (Friends' Conversation)
scenes.summary: Kristina and Sasha chat in the dining room. Sasha asks about the new chef and Kristina says she's going to the doctor.

scenes.title: Сделка  (The Deal)
scenes.summary: Chef Viktor agrees to make the sushi himself, but only if Kristina brings Vika back to the restaurant.
